title: Chio Receipt Disclosure
description: `chio.receipt-disclosure.v1` (PROTOCOL "Committed Receipts And Disclosure"): an unsigned, self-verifying opening of a committed receipt's salted commitments. A verifier opens a commitment by recomputing it; the commitment domain comes from the commitment's position in the receipt, never from the opening.

receipt_id.description: `id` of the receipt whose commitments these openings open.

salt_ref.description: Names the commitment this opening opens (`params`, `content`, `anchor.sub`, `anchor.tenant`).

payload.description: The committed value. `null` is a salt-only opening, valid only where the holder already has the payload (the caller copy, `caller` bundles and the PDP response to the enforcement point that sent the arguments).
